t: Screwdriving set with the most common screw bits and compact magnetic screw guide. TSTAK compatible to hold all accessory sets in one place. Fits inside the small, medium and large cases as well as the TSTAK compatible accessory caddy. Optimised tip geometry for full fitment in the fastener and reduced cam-out. Drive guide has an extended sleeve for improved fastener stability and control.
b: Suitable for Power Screwdrivers & Hand Tool Bit Holders
